evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing without establishing customer concerns.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Not applicable — no concerns were surfaced because the two-concerns question was never asked.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep states 'for Saturday October 31st' and quotes $222/hr early rate, but never identifies this as a Value Day or offers a cheaper alternative with a total dollar saving and flexibility ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep asks 'would you like to go ahead and get on the schedule today for Saturday October 31st?' without first stating rate lock or no-deposit language. When customer declines, rep pivots to email with no ask recovery.

top_strength: Jevic gathered detailed logistics efficiently (storage unit dimensions, fullness, furniture items, addresses, property access, parking) and built a personalized estimate anchored to typical time for a 10x10 unit, accounting for the multi-stop complexity.
coaching_note: Step 2 (Their Concerns) was completely skipped — ask the two-concerns question before any probing starts, then dig two layers deep on what the customer raises, so you can anchor the promises and estimate to what actually matters to them.
